features.note: The bay-boundary clip cross-section of L4_0788 (viewed down its axis via the writer-supplied ?cam) is still see-through: the duct interior (floor, receding walls, far end) is visible where a solid cap face should be. DECISIVE MEASUREMENT: pre-B1 (f116ce1) vs post-B1, captured on the SAME renderer at the SAME cam, are BYTE-IDENTICAL: GPU md5 equal, AE=0 full-frame and in the 210k-px cut region; SwiftShader before==after too. The stencil caps produce ZERO pixel change on GPU AND SwiftShader -> a no-op, not a renderer limitation (the inlined r160 default is stencil=true, and the GPU render shows nothing either).

defects: Stencil section caps render nothing: before/after byte-identical on the same renderer at the cut. Likely causes handed to the writer: (1) the actual WebGL context lacks a stencil buffer despite the r160 default; (2) a parked clip plane constant (1e6) leaking into the cap quad so it draws off-screen; (3) autoClearStencil/clear timing so the NotEqual-0 ref never matches.

VERIFIABILITY GAP: a stencil cap adds no mesh geometry, so neither the headless visual gate (SwiftShader renders stencil differently/not, and before/after must be MEASURED not eyeballed) nor a topology open-edge gate (the mesh stays open) can confirm it. A geometry cap (a real face recomputed at the clip plane) would be verifiable by both.
corrections: Diagnose why the stencil caps produce no pixels (verify context .stencil attribute first, then the parked-plane constant reaching the cap quad, then stencil clear timing).

Provide a verification path for whatever technique ships: if stencil, a debug mode that paints the cap a flagged color or a stencil-buffer readback; if switched to geometry caps, the existing visual + topology gates suffice.

before_after_pixel_diff.method: capture pre-B1 (git show f116ce1) and B1 working tree at the same ?cam, same renderer; imagemagick AE + md5

mechanical.note: Spec-less retrofit gate. Framing regression check PASSED (default bay isolation intact: framing-probe overlapsHUD=false, occupancy 0.3125). The caps feature FAILS: measured no-op. Orchestrator did NOT trust the ambiguous pre-look; the same-renderer before/after byte-identical measurement is the decisive evidence. INSTRUMENT NOTE for the kit: the design3d headless gate cannot verify a stencil render technique (adds no geometry -> invisible to both the visual gate under SwiftShader and any topology gate); flag stencil-cap techniques as needing a debug-color mode or stencil readback, or prefer geometry caps.
